answer: Divergent-Horizon Attestation. Each identity must publish a signed forecast of a shared random beacon several epochs ahead. Clones share one hidden state, so they either broadcast identical predictions, which collapse into a single lineage and earn one reward, or diverge and expose their fork. Enforcement compares prediction hashes across the terrace of registered agents; duplicated hashes merge accounts. An attacker must run genuinely independent forecasters per identity, paying full compute and a glacier-slow reconciliation delay per clone, so scaling the swarm costs linearly, not once.
